An empty data_as_elements list turns data-as off

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ConversionOptions, convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const options: ConversionOptions = { dataAsElements: [] };
  const result = convert("<div><span data-as=\"p\">First</span><span data-as=\"p\">Second</span></div>", options);
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
